notes.title: New game announcement
notes.content:
[h2]The big news
[/h2]Our brand new game "The Holyburn Witches" is releasing on Jan 5, 2024!  It's a unique survival-horror game with the similar eerie atmosphere of Wardwell House and 8/8/88 Needle AL.  Unlike our other games, this is all about gameplay and doesn't involve only reading.

[h2] Game description:
[/h2]You are all alone in the forests near the derelict town of Holyburn, Maine.  Legend has it that unexplained horrific events took place in this town in the early 1900s.  You must survive 4 days and 4 nights without losing your life or sanity.  Collect enough firewood and mushrooms and remember, do NOT let the bonfire go out at night.

[h2]Link to the Steam page:
[/h2] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645600/The_Holyburn_Witches/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645600/The_Holyburn_Witches/[/url]

notes.title: Wardwell House visual and control update
notes.content: To celebrate the Early Access release of our new game "8/8/88 Needle AL", we decided to improve the control scheme and increase the resolution for Wardwell House.  This is the best version of the game so if you haven't tried it before, please enjoy it now and hit us up with your feedback.
